description: This Java class 'ObjectType' provides utility methods for analyzing and converting object types in Java, leveraging reflection and type conversion mechanisms. It includes methods for class loading, type checks, type conversions, and object comparisons, and defines internal mappings for class aliases and primitive types.

classes.name: ObjectType.NullObject
classes.description: A serializable singleton class representing a null object used within ObjectType utility methods.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class by name using the current thread's context class loader, with handling for primitive types, array classes, and alias mapping.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of the specified class using its no-arg constructor.

methods.name: instanceOf
methods.description: Checks if a class or object is an instance of a given type, including interface implementation and subclass relationships.

methods.name: simpleTypeOrObjectConvert
methods.description: Converts an object to a specified type, supporting various simple and complex types, with optional formatting and localization.

methods.name: doRealCompare
methods.description: Performs comparison operations ('less', 'greater', 'equals', etc.) between two objects of a specified type with support for different data types.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a given object is considered empty for various data types.
